title: Zapier Alternatives
intro: Zapier popularised no-code automation, but usage-based pricing and workflow complexity lead many people to compare alternatives.
whyLookElsewhere: Your monthly task volume makes cost a major factor.
You want a visual builder for branching workflows.
You need to self-host automations for data-control reasons.

picks.note: A visual, canvas-based builder that many users find easier for complex, branching workflows.

faqs.q: What is the most common Zapier alternative?
faqs.a: Make (formerly Integromat) is one of the most frequently compared. Self-hosted options such as n8n are also popular with technical users.

seo.title: Zapier Alternatives: No-Code Automation Tools Compared
seo.description: Compare Zapier alternatives for no-code automation, including Make. What to check on pricing, builder style and integrations.
